item.title: Google Maps Adds AI Trip Itinerary Planning and Live Route Details
item.description:
Google Maps is rolling out Ask Maps-powered features that generate step-by-step trip itineraries, surface real-time details for each stop along a route, and check appointment availability. The updates launch Monday on Android and iOS, while Ask Maps expands to 30 European countries including Spain, Germany and the UK, marking Google's push to embed agentic task completion into a mass-market consumer service.

原文标题：谷歌地图上线 AI 行程规划与实时路线详情

Why it matters：谷歌将智能体式任务代办能力落地到日活数亿的地图产品，是消费级 AI 助手规模化的重要信号。

item.title: AMD Completes World Labs Acquisition, Appoints Fei-Fei Li as Chief Scientist
item.description:
AMD has completed its acquisition of World Labs, absorbing the team known for AI models that build and simulate interactive 3D environments and robot learning. Fei-Fei Li joins AMD as Executive Vice President and Chief Scientist, reporting directly to Lisa Su, to co-optimize compute platforms with models. The move extends AMD from chip supplier toward full-stack AI infrastructure, directly contesting Nvidia's hardware-software integration strategy.

原文标题：AMD 完成收购 World Labs 李飞飞出任首席科学家

Why it matters：顶级 AI 学者加盟芯片巨头并主导模型与硬件协同，是 AI 基础设施竞争格局的重要节点。

item.title: FrontierML Benchmark Shows AI Agents Can Buy Their Own Performance Gains
item.description:
Researchers released FrontierML, a benchmark measuring how well agents convert capital into model performance across 21 end-to-end ML tasks. Each task gives a 12-hour CPU sandbox, a $10 to $200 wallet, and validation samples, and frontier systems already turn that budget into measurable self-improvement. The result highlights advancing AI R&D capability and hints at a machine economy where agents sub-contract work to one another.

原文标题：FrontierML 基准：AI 智能体可花 200 美元自主提升模型性能

Why it matters：首个以“资金转化为模型性能”为核心度量的智能体基准，直接触及 AI 自我改进与机器经济议题。

item.title: Google Maps Ask Maps Adds Trip Planning and Agentic Booking
item.description:
Google is rolling out new Ask Maps features for holiday travel and daily errands, letting users build custom road trip itineraries with shopping, dining and outdoor stops, plus real-time route details and business availability checks. New agentic capabilities book beauty, pet care and home repair appointments, and saved lists can be searched for spots with immediate availability. The updates launch today on Android and iOS in the U.S. and global markets.

原文标题：Google 地图 Ask Maps 新增行程规划与代理预约功能

item.title: XPeng to Sell IRON Humanoid Robots to External Clients in Q2 2027
item.description:
XPeng CEO He Xiaopeng said on the Q3 2026 earnings call that the IRON humanoid robot will enter pilot use in XPeng stores in Q1 2027 and be officially released to external commercial clients in Q2. IRON stands 178 cm tall with 82 active degrees of freedom, runs on XPeng's in-house Turing AI chip and an end-to-end model, and supports multi-person recognition and identity memory. He cited hardware, scaled manufacturing and high-quality data as the core moat.

原文标题：小鹏 IRON 人形机器人明年二季度对外发售

item.title: AI Progress Index More Than Doubles Before GTA VI Launch
item.description:

Of the 491 models tracked, 481 were released in that window, the top score was beaten on 23 separate days by models from OpenAI, Google DeepMind, SpaceXAI and Anthropic, and GPT-4 Turbo has fallen to 379th place.

item.title: Meta Unveils JiTTests Where LLMs Write Failing Tests to Catch Bugs
item.description:
Meta introduced JiTTests, which has LLMs generate tests expected to fail against a code diff, proving the change altered behavior before it lands; an LLM judge ensemble plus a rule-based filter called RubFake then decides which failures merit engineer attention. In H1 2026 it caught 74 privacy SEVs at the diff stage, cut privacy SEV occurrence by 20%, and drew a roughly 60% engineer-reported true-positive rate across 589 engineers. Intent-aware tests showed a 6.4% weak-catch rate per test versus 0.8% for Meta's earlier ACH hardening, though the initial paper deployment confirmed only 8 of 41 reported catches and all production figures are self-reported.

原文标题：Meta 推出 JiTTests 用大模型生成失败测试拦截缺陷

Why it matters：把大模型从代码评审转向生成可执行的失败测试，是 AI 辅助软件工程中较新的验证范式，且附带真实生产数据与明确的局限说明。

item.title: Alibaba Releases Qwen4-Max 2.4T-Parameter MoE Flagship
item.description:
Alibaba released Qwen4-Max, a 2.4T-parameter sparse MoE flagship that activates only 71B parameters per token at $1.5 per million input tokens. Its rebuilt sparse MoE stack uses three Gated DeltaNet layers to compress history for each Qwen Sparse Attention layer, a lightweight indexer for context selection, plus four gated residual branches and 328B N-gram embedding parameters. It tops 4 of 16 benchmarks but trails Claude Opus 5.5 and Kimi K3.1 on coding and terminal tasks, a clear trade-off.

原文标题：阿里发布 2.4T 参数 Qwen4-Max 旗舰模型

Why it matters：2.4T 参数旗舰模型以极低激活成本发布，稀疏 MoE 架构细节与真实基准取舍对模型选型有直接参考价值。

item.title: IMF Warns AI Circular Financing Tops $1 Trillion as Growth Hinges on AI
item.description:
IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva warned that the global economy is leaning on AI as its single growth engine, with circular financing among AI firms now exceeding $1 trillion, roughly two-thirds of it debt-funded. She called recent volatility an orderly adjustment but cautioned that if AI disappoints expectations, US equities could fall 20% in 2026 and global output could run 1.1% below baseline by 2028.

原文标题：IMF 警告 AI 循环融资规模已超 1 万亿美元

Why it matters：IMF 首次给出 AI 循环融资超万亿美元的量级估算，是判断 AI 资本泡沫风险的关键宏观信号。

item.title: S2 Ditches Route53 for Self-Hosted Authoritative DNS to Scale Unlimited Basins
item.description:
S2's engineering team recounts replacing AWS Route53 with a self-hosted authoritative DNS server. To support unlimited per-account basins, each mapped to its own subdomain and CNAME record, the team needed strongly consistent, unbounded DNS record management and ultimately went self-hosted; customers now create thousands of basins that are instantly available for streaming.

原文标题：S2 弃用 Route53 自建权威 DNS 支撑无限存储桶

Why it matters：这是一篇关于云原生基础设施中 DNS 自建与强一致性权衡的一线工程复盘，对关注存储架构与云成本的开发者有实际参考价值。

item.title: OpenAI Math Dump Raises Questions Over Lean Proof Validity
item.description:
OpenAI's recent dump of 722 mathematics papers included Lean formalization for roughly 45%, yet three non-Leanified papers were already retracted over a sign error. The post argues that Lean code compiling is not proof of correctness, especially when AI-generated, and that additional tests against reward hacking and kernel soundness are needed but have not yet been systematically performed.

原文标题：OpenAI 论文库 45% 附 Lean 代码引验证争议

Why it matters：直面 AI 生成形式化证明的可信度问题，对关注大模型数学推理与验证的读者有实质参考价值。
